cards.verse_text: Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
cards.snippet: Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith

cards.card_text: That stern rebuke has a second goal too: there's some noise they need to tune out.
cards.verse_text: Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
cards.snippet: Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith and…

cards.card_text: Paul tells Titus to rebuke, not only to encourage.
cards.verse_text: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority.
cards.snippet: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority.

cards.card_text: And when the Lord rebukes him, the son shouldn't lose heart.
cards.verse_text: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
cards.snippet: …the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.

cards.card_text: But Balaam got rebuked for his transgression.
cards.verse_text: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
cards.snippet: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with…

cards.verse_text: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
cards.snippet: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with…

cards.card_text: The Lord rebuke you I rebuke you myself You will answer to me
cards.verse_text: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
cards.snippet: …presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”

cards.card_text: Who does He say He rebukes and disciplines?
cards.verse_text: Those I love I rebuke and discipline.
cards.snippet: Those I love I rebuke and discipline.
